notes.title: Knightfall: a daring journey is FREE! 🌹
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after a few months of discussions with the community and with the team, we have decided to make Knightfall: A Daring Journey free starting today!

The game currently doesn’t have enough active players to populate servers to start games and we don’t want to charge people for a game they can’t play. By making the game free we will hopefully get more full games going!

We want to thank all of you who have supported the game so far and we hope you can gather some of your friends up to play some rounds once it goes free next week.

If you recently got the game you may still be able to refund it through Steam.

If you have any questions or concerns about the game going free please reach out to us directly at support@landfall.se

notes.title: Knightfall is becoming free on June 18th
notes.content:
Knightfall is becoming free on June 18th!

Hello everyone, after a few months of discussions with the community and with the team, we have decided to make Knightfall: A Daring Journey free from the 18th of June at 9AM Pacific time!

The game currently doesn’t have enough active players to populate servers to start games and we don’t want to charge people for a game they can’t play. By making the game free we will hopefully get more full games!

We want to thank all of you who have supported the game so far and we hope you can gather some of your friends up to play some rounds once it goes free next week. 

If you recently got the game you may still be able to refund it through Steam.

If you have any questions or concerns about the game going free please reach out to us directly at support@landfall.se

notes.title: Landfall Archives: 23 unreleased Landfall projects!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It’s time for Landfall Day and this year we’re releasing not 1, not 4 but 23 different games and projects as their own little experience! 

Landfall Archives is a collection of every project Landfall and friends have worked on since 2016 that didn't make it to shelves but deserves to see the light of day.

Landfall Archives is free and can be found here!

[previewyoutube=X4xWDjmmt7o;full][/previewyoutube]

As you may know, we have a yearly tradition of releasing a smaller project we've made on April 1st such as Knightfall: A Daring Journey last year. We hope you enjoy this year's project! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42198690/532dc3d7c1e2e2d06e9a0bdce457c4bf04598994.jpg

To celebrate Landfall Day most of our games are also 50-90% off on steam! So if there’s one you’ve been eager to play, now is the time. You can find all of our games here!

notes.title: Knightfall Patch 5: Performance fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here's a new patch, mostly focused on better performance!

Patch Notes:


Added a healthbar to your partner's nametag.
Added shading quality option.
Increased Performance.


Make sure to verify the integrity of the game files!

notes.title: Knightfall Update 3! New Town, weapons and enchantments!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Time for update 3 (yes, the actual update 3 this time)

New weapons and enchantments:

Enchantments: 
Sonar: Reveals enemies in an area around the bullet/bomb impact.
Restoration: Gives you healing bombs or bullets.
Vampirism: Can now also appear as a bomb enchantment and gives the same stats as the weapon enchantment.

Two spellbooks:
Ice bolt: Launches an ice projectile that slows Enemies that are hit.
Ignite: Fires a volley of projectiles that light enemies on fire when hit.

New town! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26085258/85c2db9acb33fc92bdc3b148affa68f974a75b73.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26085258/e5cb516cdd37dabe7bdace96b342e09136ad5085.png

Patch Notes

Added:

 2 new weapons
 2 new weapons enchantments
 3 new bomb enchantments
 1 new town
 2 new spawns
 Added the ability to place a marker for your team
 Added quality options for models and shadows

Changed:

 Increased the number of players per match to 28
 Changed the Rose Castle and added more paths and rooms

Fixes:

 Some performance improvements


Make sure to verify the integrity of the game-files!

notes.title: Knightfall Update 2! Performance fixes, new rose castle and more!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! New patch, adding some much-needed performance improvements and a new castle!


Patch Notes: 

Added:

 Two new bomb enchantments
 Weapons and enchantments dropping on death
 Key bindings
 Invert mouse option 
 Destructible Barricades
 Ability to use firsts after being revived and dropping weapons
Invert mouse option 

Changes:

 Remade the Rose castle

Fixes:

 Performance improvements of the player character, the horses and the terrain.
 Fixed some arrow desyncing issues of the Bow
 Fixed some rose desyncing issues
 The menu buttons causing a crash

notes.title: Knightfall Update 1! New weapons and private games! 🏹
notes.content:
As the disclaimer said we weren't planning on updating Knightfall... But then we couldn't help ourselves! 

In this video, you can see a showcase of the new weapons added!

[previewyoutube=weLEB9RPLPw;full][/previewyoutube]

Patch notes: 

Added:

 24 players per match
 Four new guns
 Five enchantments
 Crates can spawn in villages and contain enchanted guns
 Five gun enchantments
 Three bomb enchantments
 Hosting private games

Changes:

 Slightly changed Ending Castle area
 Made travel distance between towns shorter
 Being far away from your partner will cause you to take damage (like your horse)
 Increased the distance you can be away from your horse

Fixes:

 Fixed some double playing village sounds
 Fixed the crosshair being misrepresentative when riding

notes.title: Patch 4 - Some GPU performance fixes, no sound gunshot bug and more!
notes.content:
Hi! Once again, we present to you - a patch! 🌹

Patch Notes:

 Updated the end castle so that the rose area is slightly bigger
 Improved GPU performance
 Fixed various connection bugs
 Hopefully fixed the issue where gunshot sounds and visuals wouldn't play


Make sure to verify the integrity of the game files!

notes.title: Patch 3: Improved matchmaking, map on horse and gates!
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing for the past couple of days! Here are some changes and fixes. 


Patch Notes: 

Added:

 Added gates to the towns that close
 Added minimap when riding and holding the map
 Added info sign to spawn camp

Fixes:

 Improved matchmaking stability
 Fixed bug where the player could fall through the level
 Fixed the horse drifting and animation getting stuck when jumping off the horse
 Fixed issue when going to the shooting range

Changes: 

 Very slightly upped bomb radius
 Slightly increased shotgun damage



Make sure to restart steam and verify the integrity of the game files!

notes.title: Knightfall: Patch 2 - Go forth without the fort!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you all for playing, seeing the response to the game has been incredible and we hope to spend the weekend fixing some of the issues you've reported to us. 


Patch notes: 

 Removed West Fort and East Fort to allow for bigger battles at the final castle.
 Optimized audio implementation performance. This should give players slightly better frame rates


Make sure to restart the game completely and verify the integrity of the game-files in order to recieve the patch!

notes.title: Knightfall: A Daring Journey Patch 1!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for playing the game, this is our first patch for Knightfall: A Daring Journey!

We're also looking at making it easier to understand the game as a first-time player for a future patch. 

Patch notes:

Changes:

 Remade some of the roads
 Made the days a bit longer
 Added wrong-way signs
 Renamed Fort to Outpost
 Renamed the East and West castles to East and West Fort


Fixes:

 Removed the horse being able to reverse run on grass
 Removed friendly fire
 Fixed bug where you would sometimes die at the game start


Make sure to verify the integrity of the game files!
